# @three-ws/home-bridge

> Connect a three.ws agent to a real Home Assistant instance: live entity state, safe service calls, a room graph for the 3D scene, and the optional Model Context Protocol capability channel.

@three-ws/home-bridge is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/home-bridge`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/home-bridge/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/home-bridge/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/home-bridge/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/home-bridge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
